description: Promote a task one level in the hierarchy: make it a sibling of its current parent (reparent to the grandparent), clamping at root level if it's already top-level. This is the relative 'up one level' move that update_task's set_parent (reparent under a NAMED task) and clear_parent (promote straight to root) can't express. Inline tasks carry their own subtree; a TaskNotes task's parent is rewritten in the vault's configured encoding — the parent's id in a parent field, or a wikilink in projects. A top-level checklist item in a TaskNotes task's body cannot be outdented ('parent is implied by location'); a nested one outdents to the top of that body. Chain if_hash from get_task for optimistic concurrency; dry_run:true previews without writing.
name: outdent_task
